About this water

The fishery source record for Lake Texoma / Oklahoma base, United States, identifies Largemouth bass, Smallmouth bass, Striped bass, White crappie, Black crappie, Blue catfish and Channel catfish.

The Oklahoma Texoma itinerary needs an Oklahoma meeting point and a named target. Ask the charter to distinguish a striped-bass program from a black-bass or crappie program, and confirm the tackle aboard. Keep the shared Texas-Oklahoma waterbody in the route and rule discussion. The species evidence does not imply a boundary crossing. Compare quotes using the same departure, fishing duration and equipment provision instead of the lake name alone.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Oklahoma

Anglers aged 18 or older generally need a fishing licence. A Lake Texoma licence has its own boundary and is not valid below the dam.

  • Selected day, ending at midnight$26 USD
  • 365 days$81 USD
  • January 1–December 31$12 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Lake Texoma licence ↗ · $12 USD
    Visitors who need coverage on both sides of Lake Texoma instead of separate state licences. Buy from a state licence vendor or the official licence system.

Rules for this water

  • Oklahoma-side striped bass/hybrids: ten daily; only two may be 20 inches or longer.
  • An Oklahoma licence alone does not cover the Texas side.
  • Use the named-water entry for Lake Texoma / Oklahoma base; check seasonal, tackle and catch limits official regulations ↗
